name: Jahzeel
title: Naftali's firstborn son
summary: Jahzeel was the firstborn son of Naftali, one of Jacob's twelve sons. He was among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family. He became the ancestor of the Jahzeelite clan within the tribe of Naftali.

keyEvents.title: Born as Naftali's firstborn
keyEvents.description: Jahzeel was born the firstborn son of Naftali and Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant. He was one of Jacob's grandchildren.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Jahzeel was among the 70 members of Jacob's family who went down to Egypt during the famine, when Joseph was second-in-command in the land.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Naphtali's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jahzeel is recorded as one of Naphtali's four sons in 1 Chronicles, where he is called Jahziel.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the Jahzeelites
keyEvents.description: During the census on the plains of Moab, Jahzeel's descendants were registered as the clan of the Jahzeelites within the tribe of Naphtali.

keyEvents.title: Naphtali's sons in Moses' records
keyEvents.description: Moses recorded Naphtali's sons, including Jahzeel, as part of Israel's genealogical history and tribal structure.
